source_info.provider: Heidelberg University GIScience Research Group (OHsome API)
source_info.query: Historical pre-event extract for Trishuli watershed (2026-07-27)
source_info.notice: Verified benchmark pre-event fixture; strict historical isolation enforced.

asset_summary.interpretation: Modeled estimates based on candidate flood extents; does not confirm physical structural damage.

connectivity_summary.hospital_notice: Historical hospital data not available in pre-event snapshot; town/city hubs utilized for modeled access.
connectivity_summary.interpretation: Modeled road-network connectivity result. Potentially cut-off settlements are settlements connected to their nearest town/city before removal of potentially affected road segments but disconnected afterward. This is a network modeling scenario, not confirmed real-world isolation.

scientific_disclaimers: Asset counts represent exposure estimates based on candidate flood extents; they do not confirm physical structural damage.
Road disruption is modeled by intersecting candidate flood extents with a 20m road buffer and 5m matching tolerance.
Settlement disconnection represents topological network fragmentation relative to nearest town/city hubs, not ground-verified physical isolation.
